# STF-2 band oven - heat and power (generated by oven_draw.py from oven.py)

- Recipe: zones 210 / 200 / 185 C, impingement 70 W/m2K top / 45 through the mesh; bake 260 s = 199 mm per zone at 2.292 mm/s.
- Result (oven.py): core held at >= 95 C for 181 s, water 18% -> 4.8%, top colour index 1.01 (1.0 = golden).
- The core sits at 100 C while it still holds water: the heat goes into evaporation (the flat part of the core curve) - that is why a thin cookie bakes in minutes and the old 20 mm puck never could.
- Steady heat 2645 W (2.94 Wh per cookie); installed 4305 W in 9 tubular elements + 3 fans; zone 1 carries 57% - it heats the cold dough and the cold band.
- Each element has its own SSR; each zone has a 3-pole C16, a zone contactor KHn whose coil runs through the zone's STB (SF4, own thermocouple element) and the line contactors K3/K4 (SF1) upstream.
- Outer skin <= 38 C (50 mm mineral wool); the puck chain runs under the oven floor and never sees the heat.
- All food data are [assumed] - MEASURE on the first bake: dough water, conductivities, the Maillard constants, and the heat-transfer coefficients of the fans (oven.py header).
